how.text:
How it would work on the TV

• Every app is a white keycap: app name as the legend, Japanese name as the coloured sub-legend.
• Modifier-style keys (Settings, Inputs) and the wide 'spacebar' with the clock carry the artwork, like the painted Esc / Shift / Space keys of a themed set.
• The focused key lifts; on Ume a plum blossom blooms on it, on Sakura it turns pink.
• Theme can follow the season from the TV clock (no internet): Ume in winter–spring, Sakura in spring, Yuki in Dec–Feb as a mood.

pick.text:
Try it: press Play on a board and hover the keys — the focused key lifts, as it would when you move with the remote.

Tell me which one (or which ones to rotate by season), and anything to change: colours, how much art, kana on or off.
